quarterly_data.quarter: Parade Technologies press release: Parade Expands AI cable performance with series of FIT (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner FIT (cable manufacturer): in cooperation with FIT, Parade Ultra Linear Redrivers (LRDs) were deployed in an OSFP copper cable included on the June 2026 PF43s InfiniBand Trade Association Integrators List at both XDR (224Gbps) and NDR (112Gbps) data rates. EVP Marketing Jimmy Chiu: OEMs can now employ Parade LRDs in copper cable solutions from 2 to 4 meters to reduce power, latency and rack weight; the Ultra Ethernet linear redriver series supports the 802.3dj Ethernet specification as well as InfiniBand, UALink, NVLink and OIF standards for the AI scale-up market. Parade offers PAM4 Ethernet/InfiniBand Ultra Linear redrivers at 56G (EDR), 112G (NDR) and 224G (XDR) line rates plus PCIe linear redrivers; no availability date stated.
quarterly_data.figure: XDR 224Gbps and NDR 112Gbps on IBTA Integrators List (June 2026); copper cables 2 to 4 meters
